table.retrieve:
SELECT	h.adjcode, 
	doctype = Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI-' ELSE 'AD-' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(h.AdjCode, 10))), 
	Type=Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'INCREASE' ELSE 'DECREASE' END, 
	h.date, 
	Round(sum(d.looseqty * price * Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0) as Amount, 
	Round(sum(d.looseqty * avgprice * Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0) as AdjustmentCost,
	Round(sum(d.looseqty * saleprice * Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0) as SaleValue,
	Round(sum(d.looseqty * purprice * Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0) as PurchaseValue,
	h.Usercode,
	u.username,
	h.posted
FROM 	adjheader h, adjdetail d, users u
WHERE 	h.adjcode = d.adjcode and 
	h.date >= :ar_startdate and 
	h.date <= :ar_enddate and
	h.usercode = u.usercode
GROUP BY h.AdjCode, h.adjcatcode, h.date, h.Usercode, u.username, h.posted
